# Long-tail format fixtures

- `longtail_iso9660.iso.gz` is a gzip-compressed ISO 9660/Joliet image generated with macOS `hdiutil makehybrid` from the text file `HELLO.TXT` containing `RustZIP ISO fixture`. The image is generated test data with no third-party payload.
- `longtail_lha_lh0.lzh` is libarchive's uncompressed LHA header-level 0 test fixture. It contains dummy text, directories, and relative symlinks. The fixture is BSD-2-Clause test data. [Source test](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/libarchive/test/test_read_format_lha.c), [encoded fixture](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/libarchive/test/test_read_format_lha_lh0.lzh.uu).
- `longtail_xar.xar` is a small XAR archive generated by bsdtar 3.7.4 from the text file `hello.txt` containing `RustZIP XAR fixture`. It is generated test data with no third-party payload.
- `longtail_rpm_bzip2.rpm` and `longtail_rpm_gzip.rpm` are libarchive's BSD-2-Clause RPM-filter fixtures, generated upstream from minimal packages containing three `hello` text files and bzip2 / gzip CPIO payloads. The fixtures are decoded from vendored upstream uuencoded test files. [bzip2 source test](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/libarchive/libarchive/test/test_read_format_cpio_svr4_bzip2_rpm.c), [gzip source test](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/libarchive/libarchive/test/test_read_format_cpio_svr4_gzip_rpm.c).
